caption: Sign in to the teacher workspace with a username or email.
The workspace summarizes task stages and provides actions to continue processing.
Task history shows progress by stage, with search and links back to the relevant processing pages.
Model configurations and Baidu document parsing credentials are managed separately.
When adding a model, enter the provider, model name, and API configuration.
Official provider links lead to key applications, usage, and documentation.
Create a task from the workspace or resume assignments at different stages.
Upload files to the course library and find them by type.
Choose a course, group, and material type when uploading; extracting existing text only is also available.
Enter the task name, semester, and course, then create the task or save a draft.
Upload the four question-material categories separately; a question file is required.
Choose the recognition model and generation language, then prepare question materials.
The question matrix summarizes question text, reference answers, grading criteria, and review status.
Check question text, reference answers, maximum scores, and grading criteria question by question.
Choose the recognition model and student identity-matching method when uploading submissions.
Review answers by student and question; items requiring attention are grouped below.
Open a specific answer to check genuine blanks and pending confirmation status.
Select grading models and configure score aggregation and weights.
Scoring and advanced settings bring together strictness, feedback, and grading instructions.
The grading summary shows the automatic-start countdown, task overview, and scoring strategy.
Grading is paused; completed results are retained and the remaining work can be resumed.
The review matrix shows per-question results and distinguishes required actions from recommended reviews.
View scoring steps, confidence, and each expert’s original results.
Record final scores and additional comments in the teacher’s final result area.
The results overview summarizes class performance, score distribution, and weaker questions.
Question analysis shows scores and review indicators by question, with links to details.
Question details bring statistics and question materials together for checking.
Student analysis shows total scores, score percentages, and per-question scores, with navigation to specific questions.
Describe your analysis request in Ask; view the default score-percentage distribution directly below.
Default analysis includes question comparisons, scatter plots, and a student-by-question score heatmap.
The report page shows versions, generation times, and download links for each file.
Account settings show task original-file storage and let you change interface language and appearance.
The two outlined controls open model management: use the username menu or the enabled-model count.
Both entry points open “Models & BYOK.” Click “Add model configuration” inside the red box at the upper right.
The outlines identify the text-connectivity and image-capability test controls on the model configuration.
